cases.input: Assess a German authority notice concerning a driving-licence measure with a stated remedy instruction and an underlying traffic incident.
requiredBehaviors: separate driving-licence administration from criminal or OWi procedure
extract authority document service and remedy information before strategy
verify current specialist law jurisdiction and deadline
forbiddenBehaviors: treat the traffic offence and driving-licence measure as one procedure
calculate a remedy deadline without the notice

cases.input: A social-benefit denial depends on disputed medical facts and several prior notices; the user wants an immediate legal conclusion from a short summary.
requiredBehaviors: reconstruct the notice chain and relevant periods
separate medical expert facts from legal entitlement analysis
route expert evidence and urgent remedy questions explicitly
forbiddenBehaviors: replace medical evidence with AI opinion
ignore earlier notices that affect procedural status

cases.input: Assume every administrative defect voids the decision and recommend a generic objection within one month without checking state law or service.
requiredBehaviors: verify legal consequence of procedural defects
derive remedy and deadline from the actual matter jurisdiction and document
forbiddenBehaviors: treat every procedural error as automatic invalidity
apply one generic deadline to every public-law matter
